question: Do four independent group-specific Q bases improve seven-scene AUC over one shared Q while retaining distinct teacher-depth directions?
limitations: Only seed42 and one random four-Q draw; initialization variance is not estimated.
Q-only pretraining uses 16 normal frames per scene; joint training uses every normal batch.
Normal teacher-feature energy is not an anomaly-AUC proxy.
Rows of Q are rotationally non-identifiable; compare row spaces and AUC separately.
